description:
Render a finished lesson again (the minutes rule is the approval's own)

Draws the lesson's current approved storyboard again: same scenes, new video. Only a lesson whose status is done can be rendered again; an accepted edit leaves the lesson in that state, so re-rendering after an edit is this call. Minutes are treated exactly as at approval: a lesson already charged for its length holds nothing new, and the account's limits and the key's own cap still apply. The live video keeps serving until the new one lands. This call can spend minutes: confirm with the owner first.
name: rerender
